senses.gloss: modala-vāḍa (IE 8-4), Kannaḍa; the chief village in a Pargana consisting of a number of villages, i. e. headquarters; sometimes called rājadhānī.
modati, cf. svarge modati bhūmidaḥ; parasmaipada in place of the expected ātmanepada.
Modina, same as Arabic Muazzin, ‘a public crier to prayers’ (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXIV, p. 144).
